itineraries.title: Five days on the Puglian coast
itineraries.intro: Bari, Polignano’s cliffs and Monopoli’s white harbour.

days.note: Board in Bari; the old town and Bari Vecchia.
The Romanesque cathedral on the water and the fishing harbour at sunset.
The cliff town and its grottoes.
The white harbour and Capitolo beaches.
The old town’s pasta makers and the basilica of San Nicola; board in the evening.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Bari to Santa Maria di Leuca
itineraries.intro: Puglia’s Adriatic shore to the very tip of Italy.

days.note: The old town’s pasta makers and the basilica of San Nicola; board in the evening.
The town on its cliffs, the sea caves beneath it, and a swim at Lama Monachile.
The whitewashed harbour, the castle and the beaches south of town.
The Roman column at the end of the Via Appia.
The Aragonese castle and the cathedral mosaic.
The lighthouse where the two seas meet.
